title: Cover and Cipher Revisited
author: Wendell Quintana
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
